imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The document-scanner guide uses exact-category Amazon text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: BeautifulMensClub.com recorded 108 impressions, zero clicks, 0% CTR and average position 39.45. The sitemap snapshot showed 212 submitted and zero indexed URLs with no errors or warnings. No non-branded query or page had a repeatable combination of volume and positions 4–20.
searchConsole.decision: No new page is labeled Data-led because the sample is too small. The report instead informed crawl and authority work: three unrelated intents are connected from the homepage, Library and two department hubs, with reciprocal contextual links and a regenerated sitemap rather than three variations on a weak query.
searchConsole.ignored: Two impressions for a jet-lag query at average position 8, two impressions for the contractor-estimate page at 8.5, one charity-page impression at 11 and six homepage impressions at 5.5 were deliberately ignored as too small, mixed or non-specific for a topic pivot or title rewrite.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow exact-category text links appear only on the document-scanner guide. The exercise-substitution and dinner-seating field manuals remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-ready strength-exercise substitution record that separates the training job from the exercise name, documents the reason for change, preserves the relevant pattern and constraint, resets the dose, records two trial exposures and defines review or professional-care gates. The document-scanner guide adds a source-linked acquisition, retention, backup and disposal matrix, while the dinner plan connects access, hearing-friendly conversation, allergen communication and service timing without presenting etiquette as law.
authority.cluster: Strength-program operating authority is strengthened with reciprocal paths from the program, RPE, return-to-training and warm-up records. The scanner guide joins the household-records, emergency-file and account-recovery cluster; the dinner plan joins the hosting, guest-room and food-safety cluster.
authority.opportunity: Logged two narrowly qualified factual-review opportunities for the scanner workflow with ENERGY STAR and the TWAIN Working Group. No outreach was sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life and Fitness: how to choose a document scanner for a defined paper-to-record workflow; how to replace a strength exercise while preserving intent and recalibrating dose; and how to seat and serve a dinner around access, conversation, allergen communication and timing. The scanner guide serves high purchase intent, the substitution record expands evidence-led training authority, and the dinner plan explores a practical hospitality problem. No page is Data-led because the current analytics sample is too weak.
